exposure: lung ultrasound (LUS0) scores within 6 hours of birth
outcome: fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) requirement >50% during first 3 days of life
need for invasive ventilation on day 3 of life
cohort: Neonates admitted with respiratory distress (RD) in a single center in South India, who received a lung ultrasound (LUS) within 6 hours of birth, excluding those with congenital heart disease, congenital anomalies of chest/lung, or chromosomal anomalies.
finding: Early lung ultrasound (LUS0) scores taken within 6 hours of birth were significantly higher in neonates with greater severity of respiratory distress and demonstrated predictive value for prognosis and severity of neonatal RD.
